training_source: SER adaptation on MSP-Podcast v1.12; WavLM-large backbone trained on Libri-Light, GigaSpeech and VoxPopuli; no clip-level overlap audit

columns.audio_path: audio file, relative to the emotion_recognition/ folder
columns.acted_emotion: ground truth: the emotion each speaker was asked to portray, from the second part of the file name
columns.prediction: model prediction: the most probable of the 5 emotions evaluated (angry, happy, neutral, sad, surprised)
columns.prediction_all_classes: model prediction: the most probable of all 9 model classes
columns.correct: whether prediction equals acted_emotion or is accepted for it (excited: happy or surprised)
columns.p_*: model probability of each of its 9 classes (they add up to 1)
